text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: Were you not able to sleep well?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Since it's a rare day off, I 
thought I'd fully surround myself in the 
breeze, ...but I never expected it to be 
calm all day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I waited and waited endlessly, and before 
I knew it, the night was far spent...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to enjoy her day off as she had 
hoped, Yamanin Zephyr seemed 
sleep-deprived.
